headline: Another empty news day; lines drift as stories fade
body: Another quiet day with no scored events. The same slow fade of earlier news continued, shaving hundredths of a point off the bright endings and adding the same to Conquerors and Zookeeper. With no fresh news, the picture is essentially unchanged from yesterday. Horizon Balance: +1.45.
movers_note: No ending moved by as much as 0.05 points (all 0.0 at one decimal); Libertarian Utopia and Conquerors shifted most, by a hundredth each, from fading contributions.
